channel.title: The Fox News Rundown
channel.description: The FOX News Rundown is your daily news podcast for making sense of the big issues directly impacting your life. Go beyond the headlines every morning and join some of FOX News’ most exceptional journalists—including FOX News Channel reporters Peter Doocy, Aishah Hasnie, Bill Melugin, Alex Hogan, Lucas Tomlinson and Jacqui Heinrich and FOX News Radio reporters Dave Anthony, Jessica Rosenthal, Lisa Brady, and Gurnal Scott - as they tap into the global reporting resources of FOX News and get unparalleled political analysis and exclusive insight from top newsmakers. The Rundown offers a sharp contrast of perspectives you won’t hear anywhere else, and a daily commentary you can't miss, we deliver the full picture of the day's biggest events.

item.title: Sanctuary Cities vs. Federal Law: The National ICE Showdown and Midterm Politics

item.itunes:author: FOX News Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
DHS statistics reveal New York has ignored over 16,000 ICE detainer requests regarding more than 50,000 crimes under Governor Hochul’s administration. Former Senior DHS Advisor and Sentinel CEO Charles Marino breaks down the conflict between local sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement, addressing officer-involved shooting incidents, public pushback, and the political implications for ICE funding and oversight if Democrats regain control of Congress in the midterms.
Plus, FOX News Chief Congressional Correspondent Chad Pergram joins to analyze how redistricting gains in Texas, Florida, and California, voter reaction to gas prices and the war in Iran, and Senate matchups in states like Iowa, Texas, and Michigan are shaping the fight for control of Congress.

item.title: Brian Kilmeade on America and the Crucial Moments That Made It
item.description: As the 2026 midterm elections approach, control of Congress hangs in the balance. In this episode of The FOX News Rundown: Extra , Fox & Friends co-host and radio host Brian Kilmeade joins host Dave Anthony to discuss President Trump's aggressive campaign trail, the key Senate races to watch, and how voters are weighing affordability and economic headwinds. Plus, Kilmeade dives into his new book, Uniting the States: Six Crucial Moments That Forged the American Miracle, exploring the fragile history of our democracy from the Boston Massacre to the War of 1812. item.title: The Pressure Cooker: How the 2026 Midterms Are Shaping Trump’s Strategy from Michigan to the Persian Gulf
item.description:
With the midterm elections just weeks away, new FOX News polls and Power Rankings show tightening battleground races, shifting voter enthusiasm, and record fundraising totals as both parties pour millions into get-out-the-vote efforts. FOX News Sunday anchor and host of the ‘Livin' the Bream’ podcast Shannon Bream joins The Rundown to break down key contests like the high-stakes Michigan Senate race, how party leaders are navigating voter dissatisfaction on the campaign trail, and the legal and political fallout surrounding the federal search of Representative Ilhan Omar’s home.
Later, FOX News Chief National Security Correspondent Jennifer Griffin takes a look at how the Trump administration is weighing military options against Iran following tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, the looming fight for defense funding on Capitol Hill, and the controversy surrounding U.S. intelligence sharing and Starshield satellite access in Ukraine. item.title: Hero Parent Stops Oregon School Shooter
item.description:
A sixteen-year-old with a shotgun stormed a Bend, Oregon elementary school Thursday afternoon and killed three children aged five, eight and eleven and a teacher before he was himself killed by an armed bystander who happened to be a parent with two children at the school. Police were called to Silver Rail Elementary School around one o’clock yesterday over a shooting in the school parking lot, but when they arrived about two minutes later the incident was already over. Law enforcement said the parent who killed the teen boy "definitely prevented more deaths."
FOX’s Tonya J. Powers speaks with Bill Daly, Former FBI Investigator and Counterintelligence Operator, who shares what we know about this latest school shooting and discusses some of the newest strategies in school security that are being implemented.

item.title: Key Showdowns & October Surprises: Sens. Tim Scott & Roger Marshall on 2026 Midterms
item.description:
Republicans are in jeopardy of losing their slim majority in the Senate, so how do they plan to keep it? With election day just weeks away, National Republican Senatorial Committee Chairman Tim Scott (R-SC) speaks with Fox's Peter Doocy about the intensifying fight for control of the upper chamber of Congress and the GOP's strategy in critical battleground states including Iowa, Maine, Alaska, Ohio and others. They break down voter concerns and President Trump rallying the Republican base.
With Republicans facing closer-than-expected races all around the nation, one of those battles takes place in Kansas as candidates there continue their blitz to gather as much support as possible before November 3rd. Kansas Republican Senator Roger Marshall joins the Rundown to explore the issues shaping his race to keep his seat in the Senate and address criticisms regarding his past medical practice collections.
PLUS, commentary by Jason Rantz, author of What’s Killing America, and the host of The Jason Rantz Show.
PHOTO CREDIT: AP IMAGES

item.title: New Signs of Younger Men Returning to Church
item.description:
At a time when America is seeing declining church attendance, a surprising reversal has pastors and researchers talking about the possibility of a new revival, among Gen Z. Gen Z has been known as the "least religious generation," but new numbers show young men are bucking the trend. It comes at a time of the quick rise of AI and how it could intersect with religious faith.
FOX’s Jessica Rosenthal speaks with Pastor Philip Anthony Mitchell, preacher and founder of the '2819 Church' in Atlanta, who says we are at a pivotal time in how we approach religion.
